title: scandix australis subsp. brevirostris
intro: Scandix australis subsp. brevirostris, commonly known as Dyer's rocket, is a subspecies of Scandix australis, a plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Scandix australis subsp. brevirostris include its ability to inhibit the growth of cancer cells, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
